scope: Development diagnostic of draft-only reading; six existing drafts and four new lead-authored controls. Not held-out writing-quality evidence.
host: native collaboration; fresh contexts; cooperative instruction-only file isolation
stop: Stop after the two registered reader tasks. No answer repair or tuning.
acceptance: All IDs/questions complete, literal per-draft evidence; all four controls correctly read in both orders; inspect event answers from six existing drafts against the separately retained source event. No numerical semantic score from an uncalibrated reader.
limitations: Same model alias and changed batch/prompt shape prevent causal attribution to source withholding alone.
Reused failure cases are development data; no held-out quality gain or reader-comprehension claim.
